priority_offer.title: Agent Delivery Proof Audit
priority_offer.description: One-time bounded evidence review of one public URL or digital artifact against up to five acceptance criteria. Includes source-linked findings, PASS/FAIL/NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW, limitations, and a timestamped report.
priority_offer.required_input: One accessible public URL or bounded artifact, up to five acceptance criteria, and delivery email
priority_offer.availability_note: Manual fulfilment. Delivery target starts only after complete, accessible intake. A listing or checkout session is not proof of a sale or delivery.

deprioritized_offer.title: Supplier Quote Comparison
deprioritized_offer.availability_note: Do not prioritize checkout-driven acquisition until the intake and fulfillment path is independently tested and its persistence dependency is healthy.
